title: SREV-152 PStore timestamp map view lifetime

mapped_view.description: MapViewOfFile returned address stored as global_timestamp

lifetime.description: owner destruction unmaps the view before closing the handle

runtime_matrix.description: Windows PStore mapping success, failure, and leak proof

contracts: section is a file mapping object handle, not a mapped address
global_timestamp is a mapped view address returned by MapViewOfFile
MapViewOfFile may fail and return NULL; the timestamp pointer is legal to dereference only after a non-null check
A successful mapped view must be unmapped with UnmapViewOfFile before or during owner destruction
Closing the file mapping handle does not replace unmapping the view
